care_group_invite_email_check.name: care_group_invite_email_check
care_group_invite_email_check.value: "care_group_invite"."kind" <> 'email' OR ("care_group_invite"."email" IS NOT NULL AND "care_group_invite"."consent_attested_at" IS NOT NULL)

note_document_owner_check.name: note_document_owner_check
note_document_owner_check.value:
("note_document"."subject" = 'entry' AND "note_document"."entry_id" = "note_document"."id" AND "note_document"."provider_id" IS NULL AND "note_document"."medication_id" IS NULL AND "note_document"."care_period_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("note_document"."subject" = 'provider' AND "note_document"."provider_id" = "note_document"."id" AND "note_document"."entry_id" IS NULL AND "note_document"."medication_id" IS NULL AND "note_document"."care_period_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("note_document"."subject" = 'medication' AND "note_document"."medication_id" = "note_document"."id" AND "note_document"."entry_id" IS NULL AND "note_document"."provider_id" IS NULL AND "note_document"."care_period_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("note_document"."subject" = 'carePeriod' AND "note_document"."care_period_id" = "note_document"."id" AND "note_document"."entry_id" IS NULL AND "note_document"."provider_id" IS NULL AND "note_document"."medication_id" IS NULL)
